dataify-google-lens 1.0.0

- Initial release of the dataify-google-lens skill for handling Google Lens and reverse image search requests.
- Implements a strict pre-call confirmation flow requiring user review and confirmation of all request parameters before API calls.
- Uses a Markdown table (参数名, 当前值, 默认值, 说明) to present all fields, always showing the full request body except Authorization.
- Defaults are only applied if explicitly documented; examples and placeholders are not treated as defaults.
- Employs a bundled Python preview helper for confirmation table generation.
- Requires users to sign in to Dataify for API token if not present; workflow halts until obtained.
- Returns API response bodies directly without any modification, summarization, or translation.
